taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Workload Identity Federation provider claims and service-account delegation
controls.source_trace: Trace external issuer claims into effective principals and distinguish provider admission from permission to impersonate a service account.
controls.implementation_branch: Evaluate issuer, audience, attribute mapping and provider conditions before IAM principal/principalSet bindings. Attribute values such as repository name can be reassigned; immutable producer IDs may have different trust properties. Direct resource access and service-account impersonation are separate grants; a successful token exchange alone establishes neither final permission.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an owned local claim-policy fixture or isolated test provider with two synthetic workloads; compare intended subject and a controlled claim mismatch.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Token exchange success alone does not establish target resource access; the impersonation/resource policy may still deny.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind issuer attributes and delegation to the intended workload, then verify approved jobs and unrelated workload denial.
